owner_selection_rationale: Current emotion assets are placeholders or future references, not an active canonical owner.
A narrow owner is required to govern emotional evidence, appraisal, state candidates, temporal lifecycle, conflict, uncertainty, and trace.
Cross-owner semantic synthesis and runtime remain outside this owner.
owns: temporal accumulation, decay, refresh, and recovery candidates
mixed, competing, contradictory, and unresolved emotion governance
emotion revision, supersession, revocation, expiration, and source correction references
emotion privacy/sensitivity, idempotency, trace, and provenance
must_not_own: Dynamic Regulation parameter or genome activation
PCN relationships, roles, or identity links
Action, Task, Scheduler, Device, Runtime, TTS, or Model execution
semantic compression or cross-owner semantic fusion
mutation_rule: All outputs are candidate-only references and cannot mutate source owners or grant authority to downstream owners.
